method: Direct view_image inspection of all six PNGs from final run-01.

images.observation: Baseline retains a flat saved-count line and compact family typography; mixed windlass records match the new desktop scenario.

Three count cards distinguish checked answers, viewed solutions and unsaved skills. Solid, striped and empty swatches explain the family strip. Earlier-setup labels and larger family/tile headings are clear.
The linear bench shows 18 eligible skills and the same three-card hierarchy; exact family counts and the current-setup provenance stay readable.
At 320px in dark mode, count cards become compact horizontal rows; shortcuts and skill tiles stack. Light text, the current-skill marker and the keyboard focus ring are clear.
At 320px with forced colors, solid/striped/empty patterns and visible card borders preserve the three categories. Status, hints and setup labels remain legible.
At 320px with computed text doubled, labels wrap and the content expands vertically without clipping. Counts stay alongside their labels and skill names/units wrap cleanly.

limits: Focused overview and first power-family tiles are captured; all applicable family counts, segment widths and tile status/setup attributes are asserted in the browser.
The 200% text case doubles computed font sizes inside the skill map, rather than browser zoom.
Real React, THREE, host module and bundled production source are used.
